title: Tail End
story: The nightly ledger reconciliation failed after dozens of routine progress lines. The incident channel only wants the lines that explain how it ended.
objective: Display only the final three log lines of the ledger container.
hints: The reason a job stopped is usually at the end of its log.
docker logs accepts an option that limits output to the most recent lines.
docker logs --tail 3 ledger prints only the last three lines.
explanation: docker logs --tail N reads only the newest N lines, the same idea as tail -n on a file. With long logs, that brings the ending into view without scrolling through the whole history.
